Decision: GO. Win probability: 98.4%.

Top probability drivers (from SHAP): (1) Strong expected evaluation score (est. 81/100) is the dominant positive driver, suggesting we are well-aligned to technical/quality criteria for a 5 MW aggregate, multi-site hospital PV scope. (2) Minimal compliance issues: only 1 gap flagged overall and 86.2% compliance (22 PASS, 6 PARTIAL) supports a low-risk responsiveness profile. (3) Tender complexity is low (3 pages), reducing interpretation risk and increasing execution confidence; budget sizing has a negligible negative impact.

Mandatory gaps and what closing them takes: No mandatory gaps identified. Close residual risk by converting the 6 PARTIAL items to PASS via a rapid compliance scrub (2–4 hours), ensuring all forms/undertakings, site phasing/commissioning methodology, warranties/O&M, and grid-tie protections are explicitly evidenced.

Recommendation: Proceed immediately with a fast compliance clean-up and submit a high-confidence, fully evidenced offer.
